<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="my">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#fff8f3">
  <title>သူပြန်လာမယ်ထင်လား</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    :root { color-scheme: light; --ink: #342329; --red: #d92d4c; }
    body { margin: 0; background: #fff8f3; color: var(--ink); font-family: "Myanmar Text", "Noto Sans Myanmar", Pyidaungsu, sans-serif; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #613fa5; outline-offset: 6px; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .page { min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100svh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 40px 20px; text-align: center; }
    .content { width: min(100%, 780px); }
    .eyebrow { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .24em; color: #9a5868; margin: 0 0 22px; }
    h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(32px, 6vw, 66px); line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 800; text-wrap: balance; }
    .art { display: block; width: min(330px, 72vw); aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 28px; margin: 18px auto 26px; mix-blend-mode: multiply; }
    .buttons { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; }
    .answer { min-height: 58px; border-radius: 20px; padding: 15px 27px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.7; }
    #yes { background: var(--red); color: white; width: 148px; max-width: 100%; font-size: 20px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #af1e38, 0 15px 28px #d92d4c20; transition: width .22s, font-size .22s, padding .22s, background .15s; }
    #yes:hover { background: #c82341; }
    #yes:active { box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #af1e38; }
    #no { background: #fff; color: #66535a; border-color: #e3cfd3; font-size: 18px; }
    #no:hover { background: #f8ecee; }
    .result-title { font-size: clamp(27px, 4.4vw, 46px); line-height: 1.9; }
    .result-title strong { color: var(--red); }
    .back { margin-top: 28px; padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #d7bbc2; border-radius: 99px; color: #6f4652; font-size: 16px; }
    .page:not([hidden]) .content { animation: enter .45s ease-out; }
    @keyframes enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
    .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }
    @media (max-width: 480px) { .page { padding: 28px 18px; } .art { width: min(270px, 68vw); } .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 16px; } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Page 1 -->
  <main id="question" class="page">
    <div class="content">
      <p class="eyebrow">STILL WAITING?</p>
      <h1 id="question-title" tabindex="-1">သူပြန်လာမယ်ထင်လား</h1>
      <img class="art" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="ခုံတန်းပေါ်မှာ တစ်ယောက်ယောက်ကို စောင့်နေသူ" width="330" height="330">
      <div class="buttons">
        <button id="yes" class="answer" type="button">ထင်တယ်</button>
        <button id="no" class="answer" type="button">မထင်ပါဖူး</button>
      </div>
      <p id="status" class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </main>

  <!-- Page 2 -->
  <section id="result" class="page" aria-labelledby="result-title" hidden>
    <div class="content">
      <p class="eyebrow">PLOT TWIST</p>
      <img class="art" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="မျက်ရည်ထွက်အောင် ရယ်မောနေတဲ့ ဟာသကာတွန်းပုံ" width="330" height="330">
      <h1 id="result-title" class="result-title" tabindex="-1">ဟိုက နောက်တစ်ယောက်နဲ့ပျော်နေပြီ<br><strong>ပြန်လာမယ် ထင်မနေနဲ့</strong></h1>
      <button id="restart" class="back" type="button">ပြန်စမယ် ↺</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <script>
    // Everything runs locally. No server or installation is needed.
    const question = document.getElementById('question');
    const result = document.getElementById('result');
    const yes = document.getElementById('yes');
    const no = document.getElementById('no');
    const status = document.getElementById('status');
    let noClicks = 0;

    no.addEventListener('click', () => {
      noClicks += 1;
      // Grow within normal layout so the other button stays reachable.
      const growth = 1 + Math.log2(noClicks + 1) * .48;
      yes.style.width = (148 * growth) + 'px';
      yes.style.fontSize = Math.min(48, 20 * growth) + 'px';
      yes.style.paddingBlock = (15 * growth) + 'px';
      status.textContent = 'ထင်တယ် ခလုတ် ပိုကြီးလာပြီ။';
    });

    yes.addEventListener('click', () => {
      history.pushState({ page: 'result' }, '', '#result');
      showPage(true);
    });

    function showPage(isResult) {
      question.hidden = isResult;
      result.hidden = !isResult;
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      document.getElementById(isResult ? 'result-title' : 'question-title').focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }

    document.getElementById('restart').addEventListener('click', () => {
      noClicks = 0;
      yes.removeAttribute('style');
      status.textContent = '';
      history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search);
      showPage(false);
    });

    window.addEventListener('popstate', () => showPage(location.hash === '#result'));
    if (location.hash === '#result') showPage(true);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
